projects.title: TransitCore – A Formally-Grounded Workflow Engine
projects.tagline: Built a model-driven state machine engine with declarative specifications, formal verification, and a custom expression language
projects.description: Engineered a complete workflow engine where business processes are specified declaratively in YAML and executed with architectural correctness guarantees. Built a custom guard expression language with formal EBNF grammar (Lark parser generator), a static verifier that proves temporal logic properties (reachability, ordering, permanence, cycle detection) on the state machine graph, and an execution engine with atomic transitions, invariant enforcement with rollback, and complete audit trails. Delivered a REST API (FastAPI), SQLite persistence with optimistic locking, auto-generated Graphviz state machine diagrams, and an interactive Streamlit demo.
features: Declarative workflow specifications in YAML — states, transitions, guards, invariants, deadlines
Custom expression language with formal EBNF grammar (comparisons, logical operators, list operations, null checks)
Static verifier proving temporal logic properties — reachability, ordering, permanence, cycle detection, determinism
Atomic transitions with invariant enforcement and automatic rollback on violation
Complete audit trail with guard/invariant evaluation results persisted via SQLAlchemy with optimistic locking
REST API (FastAPI), auto-generated Graphviz diagrams, and interactive Streamlit demo

projects.title: MiniLang – A Compiled Programming Language & Web Playground
projects.tagline: Designed and built a compiler with built-in static analysis in Rust from scratch that runs in the browser via WebAssembly
projects.description: Engineered a complete, production-grade compiler for MiniLang — a custom language with unique, highly readable syntax (AND/OR/NOT keywords, display/send semantics). Implemented all classic compiler phases from scratch: lexer, recursive-descent parser, semantic analyzer, multi-pass optimizer (constant folding, dead code elimination, constant propagation, strength reduction), and C code generation. Built a comprehensive static analysis engine computing cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity (SonarSource-style), Halstead metrics, nesting depth, and fan-out per function — with A–F quality ratings, actionable warnings, and JSON export for CI/CD integration. Delivered a polished, VS Code–like interactive playground in the browser using WebAssembly, Monaco Editor, and modern frontend tooling.
features: Complete compiler pipeline written entirely in safe Rust (lexer → parser → type checker → optimizer → C codegen)
Four optimization passes with live statistics and AST visualization in the browser
Built-in static analysis engine: cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, Halstead metrics, nesting depth, fan-out, and A–F quality ratings per function
Actionable code-quality warnings (high complexity, deep nesting, excessive parameters, high fan-out) with JSON export for CI/CD
Real-time compilation, analysis, and error reporting in WebAssembly with beautiful miette diagnostics
Interactive playground with Monaco Editor, token highlighting, optimization stats panel, and live analysis view
Production deployment on Vercel with instant auto-deploys

projects.title: Gloves Shop - E-Commerce Microservices Platform
projects.tagline: Production-ready DevOps pipeline with polyglot microservices architecture
projects.description: Designed and deployed a scalable e-commerce platform demonstrating modern DevOps practices. The system comprises 8 independent microservices built with 5 different programming languages (Node.js, Python, Java, Go, PHP), containerized using Docker, and orchestrated via Kubernetes. Implemented comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins, with infrastructure provisioned on AWS using Terraform. Integrated real-time system monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana for observability across all services.
features: 8 microservices with polyglot architecture (Node.js, Python, Java, Go, PHP)
Containerized with Docker, orchestrated with Kubernetes
Dual CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins
Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for AWS EKS deployment
Multi-database architecture (MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ)
Real-time observability with Prometheus and Grafana

projects.title: Cross Platform Packet Sniffer & Network Security Monitor
projects.tagline: Real-time network traffic analyzer with threat detection and web dashboard
projects.description: Built a comprehensive network security tool using Python and Scapy that captures, parses, and analyzes packets across OSI Layers 2-7. Features a thread-safe capture engine, heuristic-based threat detection for port scans, brute force attacks, and SYN floods, along with an interactive Flask-based dashboard for real-time visualization. Implements legal compliance notices for USA, UK, and India jurisdictions.
features: Multi-threaded packet capture engine with callback-based architecture
Deep packet inspection across 12+ protocols (TCP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, ICMP, ICMPv6, SSH, FTP, ARP, IPv4, IPv6)
Real-time security monitoring with configurable thresholds for port scans, SYN floods, and brute force detection
Cross-platform support with automatic interface detection (Windows/Npcap, macOS, Linux)
Interactive web dashboard with live packet streaming and protocol distribution charts
Rolling-window rate calculations for packets/sec and bytes/sec statistics

projects.title: HelloChat – Real-time Social Chat Application
projects.tagline: Offline-first Flutter chat app with end-to-end encryption, Supabase Realtime & Gemini AI
projects.description: A comprehensive, offline-first real-time chat application built with Flutter and Supabase. Features end-to-end encryption using X25519 key exchange and AES-256-GCM, a robust message queue with exponential backoff retry, bidirectional sync between local storage (Hive) and server, real-time typing indicators, read receipts, an integrated Gemini AI chatbot, and a soft-delete conversation system with timestamp-based message filtering. Designed to function seamlessly across varying network conditions with optimistic UI updates, automatic reconnection, and persistent offline message queuing.
features: End-to-end encryption using X25519 key exchange, HKDF key derivation & AES-256-GCM, with encrypted private-key backup on server for cross-device recovery
Offline-first architecture with Hive local storage, bidirectional sync service & persistent message queue
Message queue with exponential backoff retry, deduplication via client-generated IDs & automatic network-error classification (retryable vs permanent)
Real-time messaging & typing indicators via Supabase Realtime WebSocket channels
Advanced read receipts with precise 'Read at' timestamps and real-time read-status subscriptions
Soft-delete conversations with per-user deletion timestamps and automatic visibility restoration on new messages
Network-aware UI with connectivity monitoring, offline banner, and automatic reconnection with background sync
Optimistic message sending with instant local persistence and graceful rollback on failure
Integrated Google Gemini AI chatbot with offline-awareness
Secure auth with email/username login, unique username validation & PBKDF2-based key encryption on password change
Profile & post photo management with Supabase Storage and grid gallery
Day-wise message grouping with timestamp dividers, unread indicators & intelligent conversation sorting
